description: ONE EXPENSE ACCOUNT THIS ACTIVITY'S COST LANDS IN. A list rather than a single field because an activity almost never maps to one account — spraying is chemical, labour, fuel and machine repair — and collapsing them to one would either lose three quarters of the pool or overstate it by folding in somebody else's.

fields.description: Why this account belongs to this activity — useful where one account is shared and the reason it was included is the thing somebody will query.
fields.label: Notes

name: Cost Activity Account
